title: Training Streak and Weekly Volume
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), running gait (`gait:metric`), hangboard sessions (`hangboard:session`), golf-swing metrics (`golfswing:metric`), power-meter intervals (`powermeter:interval`), basketball shot arcs (`shotarc:make`).
app: Sports and skill sensors — velocity-based-training bar trackers, running-form IMUs, climbing hangboard load cells, golf launch monitors, cycling power meters, and computer-vision shot trackers — logged to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=vbt:rep OR sourcetype=powermeter:interval OR sourcetype=hangboard:session)
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as sessions by _time
| streamstats current=t sum(eval(if(sessions>0,1,0))) as streak reset_after="(sessions=0)"
| sort - _time
description: Recreates your training streak and daily activity across all your sports so consistency stays visible and motivating.
value: Consistency beats intensity for long-term progress; a visible streak across every sport keeps the habit alive on tired days.
implementation: Ingest sessions across your sports into `index=personal`; schedule daily and surface the current streak.
visualization: Calendar heatmap of training days with the current streak.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how many days in a row you have trained across all your sports, which keeps you motivated.
